steps.title: Dressing Inspection
steps.instruction: Inspect existing dressing for integrity, soiling, or loosening. Note any redness, swelling, or discharge at insertion site.

steps.title: Hand Hygiene
steps.instruction: Perform hand hygiene with soap and water or alcohol-based rub for at least 20 seconds.

steps.title: Dressing Change
steps.instruction: Don sterile gloves. Remove old dressing. Clean site with chlorhexidine and allow to dry. Apply new sterile transparent dressing.

steps.title: Line Flush
steps.instruction: Flush each lumen with normal saline using push-pause technique. Apply positive pressure when disconnecting syringe.

steps.title: Site Inspection
steps.instruction: Confirm insertion site shows no signs of infection: no erythema, no warmth, no exudate, no tenderness.

steps.title: Maintenance Complete
steps.instruction: Document dressing change date, site condition, and clinician name. Schedule next dressing change per protocol.
